        result = solution.encode_flag_updates([])
        self.assertIsInstance(result, bytes)
        self.assertEqual(result, b"\x00\x00")

    def test_repeated_bits_do_not_cancel_or_increment(self):
        updates = [(7, 5), (7, 5), (7, 1)]
        self.assertEqual(solution.encode_flag_updates(updates), bytes([1, 7, 5, 3]))

    def test_zero_and_byte_boundaries(self):
        updates = [(0, 0), (0, 255), (255, 0)]
        self.assertEqual(
            solution.encode_flag_updates(updates),
            bytes([2, 0, 255, 255, 0, 2]),
        )

    def test_all_255_distinct_slots(self):
        updates = [(slot, slot) for slot in range(255)]
        result = solution.encode_flag_updates(updates)

        expected_prefix = bytearray([255])
        for slot in range(255):
            expected_prefix.extend((slot, slot))
        checksum = 0
        for value in expected_prefix:
            checksum ^= value
        expected = bytes(expected_prefix + bytearray([checksum]))

        self.assertEqual(result, expected)
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 512)
        self.assertEqual(result[0], 255)
